title: Claude Code Functionality
content: Claude Code can be used in several ways. It can read and understand a code base, explaining features or tracing bugs. It can execute build scripts, run tests, and install packages based on the output. Claude Code can also search the web for documentation or API references. To use Claude Code effectively, understanding the context window is important. The context window represents Claude's working memory, which can hold a large amount of information for processing.
